Unused 'pt' translation 'Answers the unit's searches for tagged MedicationRequests and for requested Tasks, including `_include=Task:focus`. Accepts the MedicationDispense the unit creates and the updates it makes to the Task or MedicationRequest.' -> 'Responde às pesquisas da unidade por MedicationRequests com a tag e por Tasks pedidas, incluindo `_include=Task:focus`. Aceita a MedicationDispense que a unidade cria e as atualizações que faz à Task ou à MedicationRequest.'

Unused 'nl' translation 'Answers the unit's searches for tagged MedicationRequests and for requested Tasks, including `_include=Task:focus`. Accepts the MedicationDispense the unit creates and the updates it makes to the Task or MedicationRequest.' -> 'Beantwoordt de zoekopdrachten van de unit naar MedicationRequests met een tag en naar Tasks met status requested, inclusief `_include=Task:focus`. Aanvaardt de MedicationDispense die de unit aanmaakt en de wijzigingen die hij aanbrengt aan de Task of de MedicationRequest.'

Unused 'fr' translation 'Answers the unit's searches for tagged MedicationRequests and for requested Tasks, including `_include=Task:focus`. Accepts the MedicationDispense the unit creates and the updates it makes to the Task or MedicationRequest.' -> 'Répond aux recherches de l'unité portant sur les MedicationRequest avec le tag et sur les Task demandées, y compris `_include=Task:focus`. Accepte la MedicationDispense que l'unité crée et les mises à jour qu'elle apporte à la Task ou à la MedicationRequest.'

Unused 'pt' translation 'A single dispenser. As a **server** it accepts an order posted straight at it and dispenses on the spot, because posting to the device is itself the authorization to dispense. As a **client** it polls an Order Server, acts only on orders that have been made actionable, and reports back what it did.' -> 'Um único dispensador. Como **servidor**, aceita uma prescrição publicada diretamente nele e dispensa de imediato, porque publicar no dispositivo é, em si, a autorização para dispensar. Como **cliente**, consulta um Servidor de Prescrições, só age sobre prescrições que tenham sido tornadas acionáveis e comunica de volta o que fez.'

Unused 'nl' translation 'A single dispenser. As a **server** it accepts an order posted straight at it and dispenses on the spot, because posting to the device is itself the authorization to dispense. As a **client** it polls an Order Server, acts only on orders that have been made actionable, and reports back what it did.' -> 'Eén enkele dispenser. Als **server** aanvaardt hij een order die rechtstreeks naar hem wordt gepost en verstrekt hij ter plekke, want naar het apparaat posten is zelf de machtiging om te verstrekken. Als **client** pollt hij een orderserver, handelt hij alleen op orders die uitvoerbaar zijn gemaakt, en meldt hij terug wat hij heeft gedaan.'

Unused 'fr' translation 'A single dispenser. As a **server** it accepts an order posted straight at it and dispenses on the spot, because posting to the device is itself the authorization to dispense. As a **client** it polls an Order Server, acts only on orders that have been made actionable, and reports back what it did.' -> 'Un seul distributeur. En tant que **serveur**, il accepte une ordonnance qui lui est envoyée directement et dispense sur-le-champ, car l'envoi à l'appareil est en soi l'autorisation de dispenser. En tant que **client**, il interroge un serveur d'ordonnances, n'agit que sur les ordonnances rendues exécutables, et rend compte de ce qu'il a fait.'

Unused 'pt' translation 'Reading a unit is open, but changing one needs its key. A script acting with the key acts as the owner.' -> 'Ler uma unidade é livre, mas alterá-la precisa da sua chave. Um script que atue com a chave atua como o proprietário.'

Unused 'nl' translation 'Reading a unit is open, but changing one needs its key. A script acting with the key acts as the owner.' -> 'Een unit lezen is open, maar om hem te wijzigen is zijn sleutel nodig. Een script dat met de sleutel handelt, handelt als de eigenaar.'

Unused 'fr' translation 'Reading a unit is open, but changing one needs its key. A script acting with the key acts as the owner.' -> 'La lecture d'une unité est libre, mais la modifier nécessite sa clé. Un script qui agit avec la clé agit en tant que propriétaire.'

Unused 'pt' translation 'This is a plain HTTP exchange rather than a FHIR one. The publisher serves a manifest naming a version, its firmware and filesystem images, and its release notes.' -> 'Trata-se de uma simples troca HTTP e não de uma troca FHIR. O publicador serve um manifesto que indica uma versão, as suas imagens de firmware e de sistema de ficheiros, e as suas notas de versão.'

Unused 'nl' translation 'This is a plain HTTP exchange rather than a FHIR one. The publisher serves a manifest naming a version, its firmware and filesystem images, and its release notes.' -> 'Dit is een gewone HTTP-uitwisseling, geen FHIR-uitwisseling. De uitgever biedt een manifest aan met een versie, de images van de firmware en het bestandssysteem, en de release notes.'

Unused 'fr' translation 'This is a plain HTTP exchange rather than a FHIR one. The publisher serves a manifest naming a version, its firmware and filesystem images, and its release notes.' -> 'Il s'agit d'un simple échange HTTP plutôt que d'un échange FHIR. L'éditeur sert un manifeste qui indique une version, ses images de micrologiciel et de système de fichiers, et ses notes de version.'
